h1: Madonna di Campiglio ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Madonna di Campiglio sits at 1,522 metres between the Brenta Dolomites and the Adamello glaciers, and its lifts do not stop at the village: 58 of them link Campiglio with Folgarida Marilleva and Pinzolo, joining Val di Sole to Val Rendena. Together they hold 155 kilometres of slopes across 104 runs, with four snowparks and a sled run.
stayOverview: Campiglio itself is the centre, a compact village ringed by lifts. Folgarida and Marilleva are over the shoulder in Val di Sole, and Pinzolo lies down the Val Rendena.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Campiglio puts you in the middle of the lift network; the linked villages are cheaper.
rentalCars: Madonna di Campiglio is reached up the Val Rendena or over the Campo Carlo Magno pass, about an hour and a half from Trento.
